rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００４What? You want to stay here?＝＠１５０＿００５You don't mean... you're￥withdrawing as a candidate?!＝...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００６I understand... Then I'll see￥what I can do about getting you￥work here.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００７So the two who qualified are￥gone. Off to Elan...＝＠１５０＿００８I wonder if it was right for you￥to stay behind...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００９The truth is... I probably￥shouldn't say this, but...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿０１０When you said you'd stay here,￥honestly, I was relieved.＝＠１５０＿０１１If you'd gone to Elan, we might￥never... have seen each other￥again, right?＝＠１５０＿０１２Maybe I just didn't want that...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿０１３Oh, I'm sorry. That was a￥strange thing to say...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿０１４From now on,￥let's work hard together!＝＠１５０＿０１５We're on the same staff now.￥Glad to have you!
